overview: Cache-to-Cache (C2C) enables direct semantic communication between heterogeneous LLMs by projecting and fusing KV-Caches from a Sharer model into a Receiver model via a learnable neural fuser with gating, replacing text-based communication to achieve higher accuracy and lower latency.

modules.name: Tokenization Alignment
modules.description: Aligns token sequences between Sharer and Receiver models by decoding Receiver tokens to strings and re-encoding with the Sharer tokenizer. Handles template sections via length padding and message sections via maximal-coverage selection for one-to-many mappings.

modules.name: Layer Alignment
modules.description: Implements terminal alignment strategy that maps layers between Sharer and Receiver models starting from the final layers backward, ensuring deeper semantic layers are prioritized in cross-model correspondence.

modules.name: KV-Cache Extraction and Management
modules.description: Extracts per-token KV-Cache from frozen Sharer and Receiver LLMs during the prefill stage, manages cache slicing for question-aligned segments (e.g., Oracle cache enrichment), and supports sequence-wise concatenation during decoding.

modules.name: Cache Projection Module
modules.description: Projects Sharer's KV-Cache into the Receiver's representation space by concatenating both caches and processing through a projection layer followed by a feature fusion layer, reducing cross-model representation gap.

modules.name: Dynamic Weighting Module
modules.description: Applies input-aware head modulation to dynamically reweight the projected Sharer information per query, enabling fine-grained control over how much semantic content is incorporated from the Sharer at each layer.

modules.name: Learnable Gating with Temperature Annealing
modules.description: Implements per-layer learnable gates using Gumbel-sigmoid activation with linear temperature annealing from warm to near-zero, smoothly transitioning from differentiable during training to effectively binary gating at inference.

modules.name: C2C Fuser Integration
modules.description: Combines the projection, dynamic weighting, and gating modules into the complete C2C fuser that generates fused cache with residual connection, adding the fused result to the Receiver's original KV-Cache to preserve its information.

modules.name: C2C Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the three-stage training procedure: (1) forward pass through frozen Sharer and Receiver to produce KV-Caches, (2) fusion via C2C module replacing Receiver cache, (3) supervised next-token prediction loss on Receiver responses with gradients backpropagated only through C2C parameters.

modules.name: Oracle Experiments Module
modules.description: Implements the two oracle experiments: Cache Enrichment Oracle (few-shot prefill with exemplar cache discarding to isolate semantic enrichment from cache length) and Cache Transformation Oracle (MLP-based cross-model KV-Cache projection with MSE loss and t-SNE visualization).

modules.name: T2T Communication Baseline
modules.description: Implements text-to-text communication baseline where the Sharer generates analytical text about the query, which is concatenated with the original question and fed to the Receiver, mirroring standard collaborative multi-LLM pipelines.

modules.name: Query-Level Routing Baseline
modules.description: Implements query-level routing that uses embedding-based difficulty scoring to assign queries to either the strong or weak model, serving as an efficiency-oriented comparison baseline.

modules.name: Multi-Choice Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates accuracy on OpenBookQA, MMLU-Redux, ARC-Challenge, and C-Eval benchmarks using greedy decoding with zero-shot prompts, answer extraction, and option matching for all communication methods and individual models.

modules.name: Long Context Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates C2C scaling with sequence length on LongBench-E across 0-4k, 4-8k, and 8k+ token intervals, comparing C2C against T2T and individual models for long-context understanding tasks.

modules.name: Efficiency and Latency Analysis
modules.description: Measures inference time breakdown (prefill time, decode time, KV-Cache fusion time) for all methods, computes speedup ratios of C2C over T2T, and analyzes token count differences across communication paradigms.

modules.name: Ablation and Behavior Analysis
modules.description: Implements ablation studies on fuser components (Project, +Fuse, +Gate), improvement source analysis (Single, Identical, C2C), effective rank computation of KV-Caches before/after fusion, per-subcategory accuracy breakdown with Venn diagrams, progressive cache replacement analysis, and gate activation pattern analysis across general-purpose vs task-specific training.

modules.name: Multi-Model Extension and Configuration
modules.description: Extends C2C to multi-Sharer/multi-Receiver settings using unified latent projectors to decompose M×N communication into M×1 and 1×N steps, plus configuration management for model combinations, training hyperparameters, and experiment tracking with checkpoint saving/loading.
